title: New Payees on a Personal Sender Account and the Limits and Levels Callback
content:
New payees, for a callback on limits and levels to a Personal Sender Account holder, are the recipients added to the account in the 12 months before the callback request date, an addition dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting. When 4 or more were added, 2 business days are added to the counted limits callback window; when at least 2 but fewer than 4 were added, 1 business day is added to the counted limits callback window; when fewer than 2 were added, nothing is added for new payees.

## Basis Q&A

**What is counted?** Every recipient added entry on the account history dated inside the 12 months. A recipient added and later removed in the app still counts as an addition.

**Where are the thresholds?**

| Recipients added in the 12 months | Business days added |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 0 |
| 2 or 3 | 1 |
| 4 or more | 2 |

**Where does the window start?** Hypothetical dates: for a callback requested on 5 January, a recipient added on 6 January of the year before still counts, and one added on 5 January of the year before no longer counts.
